title: Ascension quests (shared/<faction>/ascension-quests.json)
description: DRAFT (M6). Path of Ascension I–V. No map location (access: teleport). Ids are slugs until a game id is confirmed; completion is derived from the wrapper story quest (storyQuests[].wraps). Next up ranks an Ascension step whose prerequisites are met first (§10).

guideStep.description: The guide step (key) whose stored tick also completes this chapter on the Journey card's Ascension bar (0.3 E8). The generator requires it to be the step that names this quest in ascensionQuest, where one does.

access.description: Owner correction 2026-10-14: Ascension quests have no map location. They unlock when their prerequisites are met and the player teleports in (Journal → Ascension → Teleport). So no giver/turn-in location, no part in location tie-breaks, and ticking one never updates the derived last confirmed location (§9).
